description: Stop keeping a note in a recurring block (the app's "Stop keeping"): occurrences on or after `from_date` no longer show it, earlier days keep it. The note itself survives. To keep it on one particular day only, link it to that day's block afterwards with link_day_block_note.

from_date.description: First day the note no longer appears (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: today (UTC).

name: stop_keeping_recurring_block_note
